youtube.title: Ganga Shiv ki jataon se hi kyun behti hain? 🙏 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Raja Bhagiratha ne apne purvajon, sagar ke saath hazaar putron, ko mukti dilane ke liye Ganga ko dharti par lane ka sankalp liya. Brahma ji ki kripa se Ganga utarne ko taiyar huin, par unka vega dharti sehan nahi kar sakti thi.

Bhagiratha ne Bhagwan Shiv ko prasann kiya. Shiv ji ne Ganga ko apni jataon mein dhaaran kiya aur phir dheere dheere dharti par chhoda. Bhagiratha ke peeche peeche chalkar Ganga ne unke purvajon ko tara diya.

Katha ka strot: Valmiki Ramayana (Bala Kanda 42-44) aur Bhagavata Purana 9.9.
